22.t: Working with data: aphids and their offspring
q: Read the number of aphids in week 5.
Calculate how many times the population grew from week 2 to week 4.
Explain why asexual reproduction lets the aphids increase so fast.
No mate is needed and every aphid can reproduce, quickly, so numbers multiply each generation.
Suggest why the aphids switch to sexual reproduction in autumn.
Sexual reproduction gives variation. As conditions get worse (cold, less food) some varied offspring may survive the winter; clones could all die from the same problem.
